digest.component_or_area: LLM code-review trigger system and project routing configuration
propositions: The committed high-precision trigger tier fires on 13.3% of diffs; the project-specific noisy tier (lock, retry, fork patterns) adds 22.0% more, totaling 35.3% fire-rate on rebar
Three traced corpus bugs trigger only through noisy-tier vocabulary and require project-level overlay documentation to be reproducible on other projects
The project overlay mechanism must merge a concurrency entry into criteria_routing.json with specific tokens and glob patterns without duplicating or overriding committed routing
A diff containing index.lock must fire the concurrency overlay when read through this repo's effective routing but not under committed-only routing (config-effect test)
The two-layer trigger design (committed precision tier + project noisy tier) and measurement methodology must be documented in llm-framework.md as an example for other projects to replicate
